ai.connect.bundle_stale: The installed Claude Desktop extension points at an older place: install it again.
ai.connect.chatgpt_changed: Not changed: ChatGPT or Codex saved {path} at the same moment. Click this button again.
ai.connect.chatgpt_conflict: Not changed: {error}. Open that file, delete the lines that mention varuna360, save, then click this button again. (Or set it by hand: a server of type STDIO with the command {cmd} and the argument(s) {args}.)
ai.connect.chatgpt_done: Added to {path}. Quit and reopen the ChatGPT desktop app: Varuna360 is in Settings, MCP servers. Codex in a terminal or an editor uses the same file.
ai.connect.chatgpt_stale: The ChatGPT desktop app's Varuna360 entry points at an older place: add it again.
ai.connect.chatgpt_tip: Adds Varuna360 to the settings file the ChatGPT desktop app shares with Codex ({path}); a backup is kept. Then quit and reopen ChatGPT.
ai.connect.chatgpt_unreadable: Not changed: {error}. That file has a mistake that ChatGPT and Codex also stumble on: open it, correct the line the message names (or restore a backup next to it), then click this button again.
ai.connect.chatgpt_unwritable: Not changed: {error}. The entry is copied: close ChatGPT and Codex, then paste it at the end of {path} and save.
ai.connect.chatgpt_unwritable_entry: Not changed: {error}. The entry is copied: close ChatGPT and Codex, open {path} and delete lines {lines} (Varuna360's old entry), then paste the copied entry at the end, and save.
ai.connect.code_done: Added to Claude Code. Start a new Claude Code session: Varuna360 is in its /mcp list.
ai.connect.code_failed: Claude Code did not add it ({error}). The command is copied: paste it in {terminal}, then press Enter.
ai.connect.code_missing: Claude Code was not found on this computer. The command is copied: paste it in {terminal} where Claude Code works, then press Enter.
ai.connect.code_no_line: Claude Code did not add it ({error}), and no command can be copied: {reason}.
ai.connect.code_stale: Claude Code's Varuna360 entry points at an older place: add it again.
ai.connect.code_tip: Runs Claude Code's own command to add Varuna360 for your user. If Claude Code is not found, the command is copied instead.
ai.connect.codex_done: Added to {path}. Start a new Codex session in a terminal or your editor: /mcp lists Varuna360.
ai.connect.codex_stale: Codex's Varuna360 entry points at an older place: add it again.
ai.connect.codex_tip: Adds Varuna360 to Codex's settings file ({path}), used by Codex in a terminal and in editors; a backup is kept. Then start a new Codex session.
ai.connect.config: Add to Claude Desktop's settings file
ai.connect.config_tip: For when the extension does not install: adds Varuna360 to claude_desktop_config.json (a backup is kept). Restart Claude Desktop.
ai.connect.install_tip: Creates the Varuna360 extension for Claude Desktop and opens it there.
ai.connect.installed: Claude Desktop is opening the extension: confirm the installation there, then start a new conversation.
ai.connect.intro: AI apps on this computer, such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code or the ChatGPT desktop app, can calculate with Varuna360: the chart open here, your chart files, or birth data you type in the conversation. They start Varuna360 in the background by themselves, so it works even when this window is closed.
ai.connect.last_call: Last call from an AI app: {when}
ai.connect.no_call: No AI app has called Varuna360 yet.
ai.connect.privacy: What the AI app reads is sent to its AI company (Anthropic for Claude, OpenAI for ChatGPT and Codex), as with anything you type there. Varuna360 itself only sends a birth place name the AI app types to OpenStreetMap, to find where it is, as the New chart form does.
ai.connect.settings_off: Changing settings: not allowed (AI settings, “Let the AI change the app's settings”).
ai.connect.settings_on: Changing settings: allowed (AI settings, “Let the AI change the app's settings”).
ai.connect.switch.enabled: Let AI apps on this computer use Varuna360
ai.connect.switch.library: Let them search and read my chart library
ai.connect.switch.show: Let them show charts in the Varuna360 window
ai.connect.switch.show_tip: A chart they show replaces the one on screen and joins your chart list, like a file you open.
ai.connect.switch.window: Let them work the Varuna360 window: tabs, chart style, divisional charts, transits, dashas
ai.connect.switch.window_tip: Changes the app remembers, such as the chart style, also need “Let the AI change the app's settings” in AI settings.
ai.connect.title: Connect AI apps
